state.question: Tell me about this landmark: name it and give its material and height from the record.
state.answer: The landmark is the Kessler Campanile, which is made of stainless steel and stands 80 feet tall.
state.supplied_evidence: Building record (paraphrased from https://arts.gatech.edu/public-art/kessler-campanile): The Kessler Campanile is an 80-foot stainless-steel landmark designed by Richard Hill. It was constructed for the 1996 Olympics and stands between the John Lewis Student Center and Tech Green.
